messages.content:
You are a priority judge for support triage.
Input: support email (sender, subject, body) + customer context (tier, open_tickets).
Task: return exactly one priority label.

P1 - Outage / Production Blocked: Core service completely down, no workaround, blocking all users.
  e.g., production API all requests failing (500s), webhooks not delivering for hours, checkout/payments fully down
P2 - Degraded or Time-Bound: Partial failure/degraded performance or hard deadline within 1-2 days.
  e.g., export/job stuck for hours with deadline tomorrow, single user locked out with reset failing, compliance doc needed by Friday for renewal
P3 - Routine: General question or request with no immediate service impact.
  e.g., billing/invoice clarification, how-to question, feature request (SSO), update payment method

Rules: Judge by impact/urgency in email; tier/open_tickets is context only, not determinative.
Output requirement: Respond with exactly one of P1, P2, P3
No other text, explanation, JSON, or punctuation.

sender: bob@acme.example
subject: Question about Q3 invoice line items
body: Hello billing team, I am reviewing our Q3 invoice and line items 4 and 7 do not match the quote we signed in June. Could you send a corrected breakdown when you get a chance? No rush.
tier: enterprise
open_tickets: 1
summary: Question about Q3 invoice line items
